content: This work explores grammar induction with compound PCFGs, which modulate rule probabilities with per-sentence continuous latent vectors. The latent vector induces marginal dependencies beyond the traditional first-order context-free assumptions within a tree-based generative process, leading to improved performance. The collapsed amortized variational inference approach is general and can be used for generative models which admit tractable inference through partial conditioning. Learning deep generative models which exhibit such conditional Markov properties is an interesting direction for future work.
